name: hitsville-drum-bus-weight
description: Broad, vintage drum-bus sweetening from the UADx Hitsville EQ Mastering — fuller low punch + de-honked low-mids + crack/sheen up top, the passive 'Motown' way (musical broad bells, no surgery). L/R stereo, both channels identical. Moves: 130 Hz Peak 3 (low thump/body) + 800 Hz Dip 2 (clear the honk/box) + 5 kHz Peak 2 (attack/crack) + 12.5 kHz Peak 1 (sheen). Measured on watercolors bus_punchy_pre (60 s) peak-normalized -1: band_ratio_low 0.589 -> 0.627 (fuller), band_ratio_low_mid 0.327 -> 0.301 (de-honked at 800), band_ratio_high 0.0130 -> 0.0159 (sheen), spectral_centroid 2223 -> 2350 Hz (slightly brighter, still warm).
intended_for: a measured-balanced stereo drum bus / drum loop that wants gentle vintage tone (low body + de-box + top crack) without the surgical/forward character of a console strip. Pairs after [[mix-balance]] and before [[master-track]]; a tonal alternative/complement to the warm tape bus or the API/SSL console strips.
plugin_build: uaudio_hitsville_eq_mastering.vst3 (UADx native — renders headless, verified. NOT the .component twin. iLok-account auth; re-verify on a new rig.)
headless_notes: All 53 params are enums; the string enums (lN_dip_pk, ctrl_link, filter, mid_side, byp, speed) MUST go through this harness, not apply-vst-chain's float dict. Per-band lN_freq is the real frequency control (the global *_speed switch is INERT in a headless render). Both sections set explicitly with ctrl_link='Unlink' for a reproducible mirror.
notes: For more THUMP move band 2 to 130 Peak 4-5, or add 50 Hz Peak 2; for snare crack push 2 kHz (l5/r5) Peak 2-3 instead of (or with) 5 kHz. The 800 Dip is the 'de-box' — deepen it (Dip 3) if the kit sounds boxy/honky. Tighten sub rumble with filter='High Pass' (the 70 Hz Motown HPF).

It is an EQ, not a transient designer: it will NOT add attack like [[drum-punch]]/shape-bands or glue like a comp. Adding lows lowers crest (denser); confirm punch with [L] measure-microdynamics if punch is the goal, and reach for [[drum-punch]] / a console strip for transient/attack.
MEASURED band peaks at amount 8 are only ~+5 dB (Peak) / -3 dB (Dip) and bands interact (passive) — keep settings modest; stack bands rather than maxing one.
